summary: fpdf2 PDF Generation Fix Testing - All 10 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified working. Fixed three issues: (1) FPDF layout error with long titles - graceful text wrapping, (2) Unicode character handling - en-dash causing font error, (3) Candidate profile formatting - missing duration/year fields from Naukri import.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/pdf_generator.py - Fixed layout issues with long text by using multi_cell when title/degree is too long for same line with duration/year
backend/services/pdf_generator.py - Added Unicode character normalization to _clean() function to handle en-dash, em-dash, smart quotes that Helvetica font doesn't support
backend/routes/resume.py - Enhanced _format_bank_profile_for_resume() to construct duration from from_date/to_date when duration field is null, and handle year_of_passing for education
backend/routes/candidates.py - Added logging for fpdf2 failures to help debug future issues
seed_data_creation: None - used existing candidates from candidate bank
context_for_next_testing_agent: fpdf2-based PDF generation is now fully working. Key fixes: (1) Long text handling via multi_cell wrapping, (2) Unicode chars normalized to ASCII, (3) Profile formatting handles various field names from Naukri import. All ATS CV downloads now return application/pdf instead of .tex.
